in_sanskrit.name: बारुण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Baruna is derived from the Sanskrit word 'barhana', which means 'dawn' or 'morning'. It is also associated with the direction of the east. This name is often used to invoke the blessings of the goddess of the dawn, Ushas.

in_marathi.name: Baruna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of oceans and rivers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baruna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baruna is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning the goddess of oceans and rivers. In Hindu mythology, Baruna is the wife of Devanagri God, Revanta, and is the mother of Yama, the God of death. Baruna is also revered as the goddess of fertility and nourishment.
